rules.title: VES scroll paper, sparks and aura
rules.reason: Replace known incompatible mesh/particle shaders and bridge additive texture alpha on these two tested weapon scrolls.
rules.validation: Limited visual smoke test in RelicHeim 6.0.0 on macOS Metal. Other scroll grades and Windows visual parity are not verified.

rules.title: Wizardry scroll and shard drop effects
rules.reason: Repair the shared drop particles on the tested Black Forest scroll and Bonemass shard without changing their item stats or original assets.
rules.validation: Limited visual smoke test in RelicHeim 6.0.0 on macOS Metal. Buildings, creatures, equipment and UI icons are outside this patch.
